trophies.label: Platinum-Critical Trophies
trophies.description: Base platinum trophy progress while locked to Grounded. Excludes No Return and Permadeath 100%.
trophies.requirement: 26 base platinum-critical trophies including the platinum pop. Dig Two Graves is route proof, not counted toward base platinum.

routecollectibles.label: Route Collectibles + Gear
routecollectibles.description: Combined PT1 chapter-route count: artifacts, journals, cards, coins, safes, manuals, workbenches, and key weapon/gear pickups.
routecollectibles.requirement: Collect all 287 planned checklist items on Grounded with no easy chapter-select cleanup.

artifacts.label: Artifacts
artifacts.description: Artifacts required for Archivist with journals.
artifacts.requirement: Collect every artifact during the Grounded-locked route.

journals.label: Journal Entries
journals.description: Journal entries required for Archivist with artifacts.
journals.requirement: Collect every journal entry during the Grounded-locked route.

cards.label: Trading Cards
cards.description: Ellie trading cards for Master Set.

safes.label: Safes
safes.requirement: Open all safes while locked to Grounded.

manuals.label: Training Manuals
manuals.description: Manual pickups that unlock upgrade branches.
manuals.requirement: Collect all manuals without relying on easy cleanup.

workbenches.label: Workbenches
workbenches.description: Workbench visits for Prepared for the Worst and weapon upgrade routing.

gear.label: Weapons / Key Gear
gear.description: Weapons and key gear pickups that unlock trophy-critical routes and upgrade paths.
gear.requirement: Collect every planned weapon/key gear pickup in the chapter route.

ellieparts.label: Ellie Parts
ellieparts.description: Ellie weapon part economy. Separate from Abby.
ellieparts.requirement: Need 970 Ellie parts for all Ellie weapon upgrades; Grounded NG has 574, leaving 396 for Grounded NG+.

elliesupps.label: Ellie Supplements
elliesupps.description: Ellie supplement economy. Separate from Abby.
elliesupps.requirement: Need 950 Ellie supplements for all Ellie player upgrades; Grounded NG has 518, leaving 432 for Grounded NG+.

abbyparts.label: Abby Parts
abbyparts.description: Abby weapon part economy. Separate from Ellie.
abbyparts.requirement: Need 950 Abby parts for all Abby weapon upgrades; Grounded NG has 591, leaving 359 for Grounded NG+.

abbysupps.label: Abby Supplements
abbysupps.description: Abby supplement economy. Separate from Ellie.
abbysupps.requirement: Need 950 Abby supplements for all Abby player upgrades; Grounded NG has 500, leaving 450 for Grounded NG+.

ngplusverify.label: NG+ Loot Checks
ngplusverify.description: Manual verification checkpoints for whether Grounded NG+ loot matches the PT1 route closely enough.
ngplusverify.requirement: Mark chapter-level NG+ resource checks until the route is proven.

deaths.label: Deaths
deaths.requirement: Turn on in Settings when this run should show deaths.
